questions.stem: 已經有許多長輩在電話中被騙，這讓他們不敢接陌生的來電。
questions.answer: Many elderly people have been cheated over the phone, and this has made them afraid to answer calls from strangers.
accepted_answers: Many seniors have already been tricked on the phone, which has made them afraid to answer calls from strangers.
Many older people have been cheated on the phone, which makes them scared to pick up calls from strangers.

patterns: S + V + O + OC（make + 受詞 + 形容詞）

questions.stem: 警方呼籲長輩，若被要求轉帳，要先和家人確認。
questions.answer: The police urge elderly people to check with their families first if they are asked to transfer money.
accepted_answers: The police advise older people to check with their family first if they are told to transfer money.
The police call on the elderly to confirm with their family members first if they are asked to send money.

patterns: 動詞＋受詞＋不定詞（urge sb to V）

1.explanation_zh: 「已經有許多長輩…被騙」的重點是長輩「已經被騙」：以 many elderly people 當主詞，用完成式被動 have been cheated，「已經」也可以明寫成 have already been cheated；「被騙」除了 cheated，也可以用電話詐騙最常說的 scammed，或 tricked、deceived。「在電話中」是 over the phone／on the phone。後半句「這讓他們不敢…」是 make + 受詞 + 形容詞（受詞補語）：this has made them afraid to answer …（或 which makes them scared to …）；「不敢」用形容詞 afraid（to VR），不要寫 don't dare。「陌生的來電」是陌生人打來的電話：calls from strangers 或 calls from unknown numbers。
evidence: 已經有許多長輩在電話中被騙
這讓他們不敢接陌生的來電
1.strategy_zh: 中文「已經有…被…」先找出真正的主詞，再用完成式被動；「讓＋人＋（感覺）」常用 make + O + adj.。
hints: 切成四段：已經有許多長輩／在電話中被騙／這讓他們不敢／接陌生的來電
標的詞彙：elderly（年長的）、cheat（欺騙，也可用 scam、trick）、phone（電話）、afraid（害怕的）、answer（接〔電話〕）、stranger（陌生人）
句型框架：S + have (already) been + p.p. …, and this has made + O + adj. + to VR …

2.explanation_zh: 「呼籲／提醒＋人＋做某事」是 urge（或 remind、advise、call on）+ 受詞 + to + 原形動詞：The police urge elderly people to check with their families first；the police 恆用複數動詞，不加 s。「若被要求轉帳」是長輩「被」要求，用被動 if they are asked to transfer money；中文沒有主詞，英文要補 they。「和家人確認」是 check with their families（family 當集合名詞寫 their family，或寫 family members 都可以），「先」要譯出 first。
2.strategy_zh: 「呼籲／提醒／鼓勵／警告＋人＋做…」先想 V + O + to VR；中文的「被要求」「被告知」用 be asked／be told。
hints: 切成四段：警方呼籲長輩／若被要求／轉帳／要先和家人確認
標的詞彙：police（警方）、urge（呼籲，也可用 remind、advise）、elderly（年長的）、transfer（轉帳）、check（確認；check with）、family（家人）
句型框架：S + urge + O + to VR … first + if + S + be + asked + to VR

traps.literal_error: There are already many elderly people have been cheated over the phone.
traps.explanation_zh: 「已經有…被騙」的「有」是存在句，照字面譯成 There are … have been … 會出現兩個主要動詞；直接以 many elderly people 當主詞。

1.restructuring_zh: 「已經有許多長輩在電話中被騙」不要譯成 There are …，改以 many elderly people 當主詞，用完成式被動 have been cheated（補主詞或改被動）；「這讓他們不敢…」用 this has made them afraid to …。

warnings: annotations.rubric.items.1.patterns[1]: gp-perfect-passive 通常對應句構 PERF（目前 code=PASS）

1.translation: Many elderly people have already been cheated over the phone, which makes them afraid to answer calls from strangers.
1.explanation_zh: 「已經……被騙」是到現在為止的經驗，用現在完成式被動 have already been cheated；「這讓他們……」指前面整件事，用逗號加 which 的非限定關係子句；「不敢」譯 be afraid to V；「陌生的來電」譯 calls from strangers（也可說 calls from unknown numbers）。

2.translation: The police urge elderly people to check with their family members first if they are asked to transfer money.
2.explanation_zh: 「呼籲某人做某事」用 urge sb to V；the police 當複數；「若被要求轉帳」是條件副詞子句，用 if 加被動 are asked to transfer money；「先和家人確認」譯 check with their family members first。

issues_zh: （小建議，不影響判定）第 3 部分可接受寫法有不帶連接詞的片段（made them afraid、makes them afraid 等），逐段比對時「…over the phone, this made them afraid…」這種逗號連接兩個子句的寫法也會過關；另外 reluctant／hesitant 和第 4 部分的 of answering 拼起來會變成錯誤搭配（reluctant of answering），批改時要看整句。
（小建議）第 1 部分中文寫「已經有許多長輩」，但「已經」對應的 already 在第 2 部分的可接受寫法裡，切分標示可以把「已經」移到第 2 部分。

1.translation: Many elderly people have already been scammed over the phone, which makes them afraid to answer calls from strangers.
1.explanation_zh: 「已經有許多長輩被騙」是到現在為止的結果，所以用現在完成式被動（have already been scammed）；「這讓他們不敢……」指前面整件事造成的結果，用非限定關係子句 which makes them afraid to ...。「不敢接電話」譯成 afraid to answer calls；「陌生的來電」用 calls from strangers，簡單自然。

2.translation: The police urge elderly people to check with their families first if they are asked to transfer money.
2.explanation_zh: 「呼籲長輩……」用 urge ... to V；「和家人確認」是 check with their families；「若被要求轉帳」是被動語態，用 if they are asked to transfer money，並放在句尾，讓主要訊息先出現。
